text: {"fixed_clause": "The Vendor may engage third-party subcontractors for data processing activities, provided it ensures they offer sufficient guarantees to implement applicable data protection law, and the Client shall have the right to conduct reasonable on-site audits and compliance reviews of the Vendor's operational facilities to monitor such compliance."}

data.fixed_clause: The Vendor may engage third-party subcontractors for data processing activities, provided it ensures they offer sufficient guarantees to implement applicable data protection law, and the Client shall have the right to conduct reasonable on-site audits and compliance reviews of the Vendor's operational facilities to monitor such compliance.
